rationale: Reset release is conditioned on bus_avail_i, but the design does not state whether that signal is synchronized to this clock or how long the external target logic remains isolated; the reset-consumer safety cannot be decided without that contract.

mutation.description: Reduced the target reset controller to its enable, recovery, and bus-available state sequence.
